bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root/.git" || exit 61
test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree)" = true || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 64
test -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" || exit 65
test -f "$root/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" || exit 66
echo "BASELINE_REPO_HEAD=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "DEPLOY_IMAGE=$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
echo "SOURCE_BRANCH=chat/link-button-master-final-20261120"
echo "PROD_NOT_MODIFIED=TRUE"
